info.title: Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

VLAN.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding)
Reference to a [VLAN](#/VLAN) on which a MGMD protocol detects multicast traffic over specific interfaces.

address_family.description: Represents the address family for this entry. Default value is `ipv4`.

destination_prefix.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding)
IPv4 or IPv6 destination prefix. Example 255.0.10.1/32

num_retries_requested.description: Number of retries requested for configuring this entry in hardware.

hw_status.description: Status information to indicate the current state of the hardware.

activity.description: Specifies the [Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding](Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding) entry activity status during a period of time. This value is updated periodically (by default, every 5 seconds). When set to `active` it indicates the [Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding](Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding) entry route is actively participating in multicast traffic. If no activity is seen after the last update, the value will be set to `inactive`.

num_retries_performed.description: Number of times the retries have been performed to the hardware.

last_data_rx_timestamp.description: The epoch time at which the last l2 multicast packet for this multicast stream was received.

packet_exceptions_count.description: Number of unknown l2 multicast packets punted to the CPU.

replication_group.description:
Reference Resource: [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group)
Reference to a [Replication_Group](#/Replication_Group) which containts the hardware configuration for the entry.

replication_portset.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_Replication_Portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset)
Reference to a [Multicast_Replication_Portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset) which contains a null reference in [l3_port](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset) and one or more entries in [l2_portset](#/Multicast_Replication_Portset)

source_prefix.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding)
IPv4 or IPv6 source prefix. Example 192.168.0.1/32

vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding)
Reference to a [VRF](#/VRF), to which this multicast L3 bridge control forwading entry belongs. Since [Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding](#/Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding) is using IP addresses in [source_prefix](#/Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding) and [destination_prefix](#/Multicast_L3_Bridge_Control_Forwarding), a VRF is needed to be able to associate those IP addresses to the VRF when programming the hardware. [Bridge](#/Bridge) is obtained from the [VRF](#/VRF). When the [VLAN](#/VLAN) does not have an IP address then the default VRF is used.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
